testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between appearance and panel visibility submenus: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:139:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between appearance and panel visibility submenus ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon uses the Normal appearance ✔ And Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands are enabled in Show Panels ✔ And Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands are enabled in Show Panels ✔ When the user right-clicks the Options panel title ✔ And the user opens the Ribbon Appearance submenu ✔ Then Normal is marked as selected ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the same context menu ✔ Then the appearance submenu closes ✔ And the Show Panels submenu lists Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find, Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands with visibility checks ✔ And Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands are checked in the captured panel state ✔ And the panel context menu remains open ✔ When the user opens Ribbon Appearance again ✔ Then the Show Panels submenu closes ✔ And Normal is still marked as selected ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then both menus close ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
